purpose: Select a portable coach mode, independently of research-panel and training outcomes.
distribution: Alternate the two lineups by seed within each panel; rotate the opponents' cyclic order on each repeated lineup and rotate the focal agent through all four seat positions for each seed.
portableGate: Score terminal split win credit. For expanded-board, require a paired mean gain of at least .02 AND lower bound of the nominal two-sided 95% deal-block interval >0 against EVERY baseline in BOTH panels. For expanded-urgency, require the same comparisons plus a gain of at least .02 and lower bound >0 over expanded-board in both panels. No selection based on table-only policy; full table research remains separate. Keep frozen weights regardless.
shortlistComparison: On these same held-out deals compare expanded-board and expanded-table against their own fitted coefficients scored over the original four-action shortlist, to isolate the expansion at inference. Shortlisted variants and full-table policy are explanatory contrasts only.
notes: Nominal intervals by pre-specified contrast. Games have common seed and every rotation for each agent. The five required baseline tests form a conjunction: a failed contrast prevents promotion. No threshold/weight changes on these panels.
